take_homes: Giving people the tool is not the same as them using it. Using takes weeks and needs someone they trust.
Before I build anything, ask one person how they do the job now. That is what I have to beat.
Plans are guesses. Test with one person first.

monday.move: Ask one depot manager how he makes the weekly shift plan today and what annoys him
monday.when: Next time I am at the depot, maybe Tuesday
monday.stop_condition: If he says it works fine and nothing annoys him, I drop it
monday.blocker: No time. And I only try this if it touches reporting I can't export without IT.

misconception.why: I still think of AI as a customer chatbot. But the 'one person, how they do the job today' idea fits my depots, so maybe it is for operations too. I am not sure yet because I never saw an operations example. The exercises were all abstract.

one_line: Too much English text and filler, but the point is good: giving access is not use, so go ask one person how he works today. I would have liked a depot example.
